Privacy.
Clearly explained.

This page explains what happens to the information you share through this website.

Enquiries and introductions

When you send the project, career or partnership form, we receive your name, email address, company, location, the details you choose to add and the page you sent it from. They are stored in a private Google Sheet used by the Space Craft team, and we use them to reply to you.

Who handles it

Google provides the spreadsheet service and processes this information on our behalf under its own terms. Access to the sheet is limited to the Space Craft team. To ask us to correct or delete your details, send a message through the contact page.

Hosting

This site is a static website hosted on Vercel. The hosting provider may process standard request information, such as IP addresses and request logs, under its own policies. The website does not have user accounts.

Cookies, maps and links

This site does not use advertising trackers or analytics scripts. Photographs are served from the site’s own assets. Map links open Google Maps; its privacy terms apply when you follow them.
